system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: 在 Agent 面板中控制环境、规则、知识上下文及延迟工具清单等提示词注入项，并在配置变化后即时重载
system_prompt_style.note: agent/dev/system.md plus rule/ and env.md files composed with injection toggles.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: We designed a proprietary intermediate representation that lets agents progressively read large scenes and assets, along with retrieval tools that help agents quickly locate target objects
env_context_strategy.note: README prose only, no line number available in excerpt; agent uses retrieval tools to navigate scenes/assets. Long-term memory of project understanding also mentioned (possible injected context), not confirmed as default prompt injection.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: 有效上下文与自动压缩阈值随配置同步调整
context_compaction.note: Automatic compaction (Remote Compaction V2) plus output-budget truncation in unity_yaml_read returning continuable sub-paths.

observation_format.evidence_quote: 上下文压缩、历史分页与轮次导航会保留图片提示
observation_format.note: Image turns supported; viewport capture bridge (LocusBridge.CaptureViewport.cs) present.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Provider 预告后未出现在最终响应中的工具调用，不再显示为空的已完成调用。
tool_call_format.note: Uses provider tool-call APIs (OpenAI Responses/Chat Completions, Anthropic Messages).

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: **原子批量编辑。** `edit` 可基于同一份原始文件快照执行多处独立替换，全部校验成功后一次写入。

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: 支持从 `user-agents` 加载用户 Agent 与工具描述覆盖
tool_schema_source.note: Tool descriptions are authored text overridable by users; schema generation code not visible in evidence.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: This enables WebView2 debugging and Codex MCP
protocol_standardization.note: Also scripts/chrome-devtools-mcp-wrapper.mjs; README notes Locus itself is not an MCP server.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: 制定实施方案，经审阅后执行
loop_primitives.note: Plan mode documented (docs/sessions/plan-mode.mdx, prompt/plan-reminder.md); default is the tool-calling loop.

planning_granularity.note: Plan mode with dedicated prompts and docs/sessions/plan-mode.mdx; structure of the plan object not shown.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: 同一工具轮次中的前台 subagent 会先完成，再执行本地同级工具
multi_agent_topology.note: Subagents exist (explorer/doc/wiki agent configs); default session appears to be the dev agent orchestrating optional subagents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: 子 Agent 的完整运行循环改为使用独立 Tokio 任务，使父工具循环、工具执行与子 LLM 循环拥有分离的任务栈

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: **危险命令拦截。** Bash、PowerShell 和 CMD 中的强制删除命令默认请求批准。
human_in_loop.note: docs/sessions/permissions.mdx and plan-mode review; Codex auto-approval review is optional.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: 新增上下文用量窗口，按系统提示、运行时注入、会话消息和工具结果拆分 token 占用
short_term_state.note: Session state tracked beyond messages (context windows, plan mode, tool state).

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: agent会把每次接到的零散对话需求总结成设计文档，并把工作中的理解保存到memory中
long_term_memory.note: Markdown knowledge docs (Design/Memory/Reference), Skill packs in skills/, and semantic retrieval with downloadable embedding runtimes.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: 从压缩前的历史位置创建分叉时，Locus 会重建对应的活动上下文窗口
state_persistence.note: Sessions persisted in local database and can be switched/forked/continued.

self_verification.evidence_quote: The agent sees compiler-grade errors and warnings the moment it changes code, without waiting for Unity to compile
self_verification.evidence_locator: README.md What Makes Locus Technically Different@a13cec09
self_verification.note: Roslyn diagnostics automatic; Unity Test tool discovers/runs Edit and Play Mode tests; Codex approval review is an LLM review of pending actions.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: 服务端压缩失败时保留原上下文并停止当前运行
retry_policy.note: No task-level retry policy described; failures stop the run.

rollback.evidence_quote: Locus 依赖版本管理工具实现「撤销」及「变更分析」等功能。
rollback.note: Also agent-side version management to review/revert agent changes; docs/sessions/changes-and-undo.mdx.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: ChatGPT 订阅模型支持 16K 至 1M Tokens，默认 272K
termination_condition.note: Turn ends when the model stops requesting tools; context window configurable and compaction triggers at threshold.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Codex 与自定义供应商可设置提示词前缀缓存有效期
cost_controls.note: Configurable context window / compaction threshold acts as token budget; prompt caching with cache-invalidation diagnostics.

timeouts.evidence_quote: 后台 Shell 与 Unity Test 任务会持续运行至完成或取消，不再应用同步执行超时
timeouts.note: Synchronous tool execution timeout exists; also recompile timeout diagnostics. No run-level timeout found.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Locus is a standalone Rust + Tauri + Vue.js application that runs as an independent process.
execution_isolation.evidence_locator: README.md What Makes Locus Technically Different@a13cec09
execution_isolation.note: Shell/Skill/dev-server child processes run on the host Windows machine against the real Unity project; no sandbox described.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: 文件写入、Shell 工作目录和命令路径统一遵守附加工作目录的只读约束。
filesystem_access.note: Workspace-scoped resolution with read-only additional directories.

network_policy.evidence_quote: 除所配置的远程模型服务调用外，Locus 为纯客户端软件，其余任何信息均不会上传至互联网。
network_policy.note: No egress restriction mechanism described; web_search and doc import reach the network.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Bash、PowerShell 和 CMD 中的强制删除命令默认请求批准。
permission_model.note: Approval prompts for risky actions; optional Codex structured auto-approval review assigns risk levels (policy_engine-like).

tracing.evidence_quote: 会话回顾会创建独立聊天、异步导出上下文，并将导出文件放入输入区供发送前检查
tracing.note: Context export and logs directory; no OpenTelemetry mentioned in evidence.

replayability.note: Session replay script for stress testing; environment differs.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Debug 模式提供确定性的流式回复、工具调用与错误回复预设，全程本地运行。
eval_hooks.note: Only internal stress/mock test harnesses; no benchmark evaluation runner in the repo tree.

guardrails.evidence_quote: **危险命令拦截。** Bash、PowerShell 和 CMD 中的强制删除命令默认请求批准。
guardrails.note: Knowledge doc four-state editing constraints enforced in tools; read-only directory enforcement.
